title: Community-Gated Adaptation and Poisoning Evaluation
research_question: Does multi-witness community gating successfully authorize legitimate continual profile adaptation while rejecting or quarantining poisoning, replay, and target-like spoofing attacks compared to naive single-receiver baselines?

adversary_capabilities: Target-like spoofing: Attacker crafts transmissions mimicking target transmitter features
Gradual poisoning / creep: Attacker injects incremental malicious drifts to corrupt stored profile
Replay attacks: Attacker retransmits captured legitimate preambles out-of-context
Single-gateway compromise: Attacker controls or deceives a single witnessing gateway
adversary_limitations: Attacker cannot simultaneously deceive multiple independent spatially-distributed gateways with consistent multi-angle RF signatures
Attacker cannot alter gateway-to-gateway consensus backhaul
trust_assumptions: Majority of witnessing gateways are non-colluding
Profile updates are persistent only when explicitly authorized by the gating contract

leakage_controls: Identity classification decision strictly separated from update authorization
Synthetic attack scenarios evaluated under fixed deterministic seeds
No claim that synthetic poisoning defenses guarantee real-world physical security without further testing
